pieces.title: Tiger
pieces.summary: A handmade tiger portrait. The painted face blinks and watches from its frame.
pieces.filmNote: The painting was made by hand. Motion was added afterward so the original brushwork could breathe.

pieces.title: MoonFlowers
pieces.summary: A film made from many stills of a painting as color blooms across a dark field.
pieces.filmNote: Each frame is a photo of the physical painting. The film only crops, steadies, and quickens those stills.

pieces.title: SpeakEasy
pieces.summary: A night street built frame by frame, from ink line to neon wash.
pieces.filmNote: A handmade street scene, photographed as it grew and cut together from those stills.

pieces.title: Artwork studio
pieces.summary: The studio for hand-made paintings and the films made from them.
